blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Long-term conversational memory requires retrieving complementary facts scattered across dialogue sessions, including intermediate evidence with limited similarity to the original question. Existing approaches often rely on derived memory representations or persistent relational structures, introducing construction costs and potentially losing source details. We present SAG-Mem, a conversational memory framework that preserves complete dialogue messages in non-overlapping chunks and discovers complementary evidence through query-time lexical expansion. Memory construction requires no model inference, using a lexical index without LLM-based extraction, summarization, or semantic relation construction. At query time, BM25 retrieves initial candidates, an evidence evaluator identifies useful chunks, and lexical cues from selected evidence guide an additional retrieval round. Retrieved dialogue is further annotated with calendar interpretations of supported relative-time expressions, preserving the original wording and temporal granularity. We also introduce SAG-Mem-Lite, an alternative configuration that replaces evidence scoring with embedding-based candidate scoring, achieving lower operational cost than Full Context and all memory-based baselines across both benchmarks with low query latency. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval, SAG-Mem achieves overall scores of 83.08 and 80.20, respectively, the highest among the evaluated methods on both benchmarks. On LongMemEval, it exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 7.20 points. SAG-Mem-Lite achieves scores of 77.09 and 77.20, respectively. These results support dialogue preservation and evidence-guided retrieval expansion as an effective design for long-term conversational memory.
blocks.zh: 长期的对话记忆需要取回分散在对话会中的补充事实,包括与原问题有有限相似性的中间证据. 现有方法往往依靠衍生的内存表示或持续的关系结构,引入了施工成本并有可能丢失源细节. 我们提出SAG-Mem,这是一个对话记忆框架,它以非重叠块保存完整的对话信息,并通过查询-时间语法扩展发现补充证据. 内存构造不需要模型推论,不用LLM的提取,归纳,或语义关系构造而使用词典索引. 在查询时,BM25检索了初始候选人,一名证据评估员鉴定了有用的块,选定证据的词汇提示指导了额外的检索回合。 检索到的对话还附加了对支持的相对时态的日历解释,保留了原始措辞和时间颗粒性. 我们还采用了SAG-Mem-Lite,这是一种替代配置,用嵌入式候选人分数取代证据分数,实现比Full Control和所有基于内存的基线更低的运行成本,同时使用低查询间隔的基准。 在"LoCoMo"和"LongMemEval"上,SAG-Mem的总分分别为83.08分和80.20分,是两个基准上评价方法中最高的. 在LongMemEval上,它超过了最强的基线7.20分. SAG-Mem-Lite分别取得了77.09分和77.20分的分数. 这些结果支持对话保存和由证据指导的检索扩展,作为长期对话记忆的有效设计.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Long-term conversational memory enables language models to answer questions using information accumulated across past interactions ( Packer et al., 2023 ) .
As dialogue histories grow, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides a way to access relevant information without placing the entire history in the model’s context ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) .
However, answering a question may require complementary facts distributed across sessions, together with their conversational and temporal context ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) .
Retrieval based on similarity to the original question may miss intermediate evidence whose relevance emerges only after other facts are found ( Qi et al., 2019 ; Trivedi et al., 2023 ) .
This motivates using retrieved evidence to guide further search beyond the initial candidate pool.
blocks.zh:
长期的对话记忆使语言模型能够利用过去互动中积累的信息回答问题(Packer等人,2023年).
随着对话历史的增长,检索增强的生成(RAG)提供了一种获取相关信息的方式,而不将整个历史置于模型的背景中(Lewis等人,2020年)。
然而,回答一个问题可能需要在各届会议上散发补充事实,以及它们的对话和时间背景(Maharana等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年)。
基于与原问题相似的检索可能错过中间证据,而中间证据的相关性只有在发现其他事实后才出现(Qi等人,2019年;Trivedi等人,2023年).
这促使利用检索到的证据指导在最初候选人库之外进行进一步搜索。

blocks.en:
Memory systems address this problem through different choices of representation and organization.
MemoryBank ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) generates event summaries and user profiles, while RMM ( Tan et al., 2025 ) summarizes interactions at multiple granularities.
Mem0 ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) extracts and consolidates salient information into persistent memory entries.
For relational organization, A-MEM ( Xu et al., 2026b ) links memory notes and updates their contextual representations, while Zep ( Rasmussen et al., 2025 ) organizes extracted entities and facts in a temporal knowledge graph.
These representations can facilitate retrieval, but generating and updating them requires model inference and incurs recurring token costs during memory ingestion.
Moreover, details omitted from these representations may later be needed to answer a question or connect evidence across sessions.
Recent results with Raw-RAG ( Bao et al., 2026 ) show that dense retrieval and reranking over raw conversation history can outperform the compared agentic memory systems, highlighting the importance of preserving source information and the supporting relations needed to derive answers.
These observations motivate a design that stores source dialogue directly and uses retrieved evidence to guide further search for complementary information.
blocks.zh:
记忆系统通过不同的代表性和组织选择来解决这一问题。
MemoryBank(Zhong等人,2024年)生成事件摘要和用户简介,而RMM(Tan等人,2025年)则总结多个颗粒的相互作用.
Mem0(Chhikara等人,2025年)将显著信息提取并整合到持续记忆条目中.
对于关系组织,A-MEM(Xu等人,2026年b)将内存说明链接并更新其背景表述,而Zep(Rasmussen等人,2025年)则在时间知识图中组织提取的实体和事实.
这些表示可以方便检索,但生成和更新它们需要模型推论,并在内存摄入过程中产生经常性的代号费用.
此外,以后可能需要这些陈述中遗漏的细节来回答一个问题或将各种会议的证据联系起来。
最近与Raw-RAG(Bao等人,2026年)的结果表明,密集的检索和重排在原始对话历史之上,可以超越比较的代理记忆系统,突出了保存源信息的重要性以及获取答案所需的支持关系.
这些观察促使设计直接存储源对话,并利用检索的证据指导进一步搜索补充信息。

blocks.en:
Temporal interpretation is another concern when using small Reader models ( Chu et al., 2024 ; Fatemi et al., 2024 ) .
Expressions such as yesterday and last month depend on the date of the original message rather than the date of the current question ( Rasmussen et al., 2025 ) .
Even when the correct evidence is retrieved, the Reader must identify the appropriate reference date and translate the relative expression before answering.
Temporal normalization offers an established way to make such expressions explicit through standardized calendar representations ( Strötgen and Gertz, 2010 ; Chang and Manning, 2012 ) .
This motivates providing explicit calendar interpretations of supported expressions to reduce the temporal reasoning required of the Reader.
blocks.zh:
时间解释是使用小读者模型时的另一个关切问题(Chu等人,2024年;Fatemi等人,2024年)。
例如昨天和上个月的表达取决于原始消息的日期,而不是当前问题的日期(Rasmussen等人,2025年)。
即使找到正确的证据,读者也必须确定适当的参考日期,并在回答之前翻译相对表达.
时间正常化提供了一种既定方式,通过标准日历表述来明确这种表达方式(Strötgen和Gertz,2010年;Chang和Manning,2012年)。
这促使对支持的表达式提供明确的日历解释,以减少读者所需的时间推理.

blocks.en: These considerations lead to three research questions. RQ1: Memory construction. Can direct dialogue storage reduce costs while preserving the original details needed for accurate question answering across long conversations spanning multiple sessions? RQ2: Evidence discovery. Can evidence-guided lexical expansion recover complementary facts across sessions, including intermediate evidence that is poorly matched to the original query but needed to derive the answer? RQ3: Temporal interpretation. Can deterministic date annotations improve temporal question answering with small Reader models by resolving relative expressions against source message dates?
blocks.zh: 这些考虑导致三个研究问题。 RQ1:记忆建筑. 直接对话存储能否降低成本,同时在跨越多个会话的长长对话中保留准确回答问题所需的原始细节? RQ2:证据发现. 由证据指导的词汇扩展能否收回不同会期的补充事实,包括中间证据,这些证据与最初的询问不相符,但需要获得答案? RQ3:临时解释. 确定日期说明能否通过对照源消息日期解析相对表达式来用小的阅读器模型改进时间问题的回答?

blocks.en:
Building on SAG2 ( Wu, 2026 ) , we present SAG-Mem , which adapts evidence-guided lexical retrieval to conversational memory.
It indexes complete messages in non-overlapping chunks within each session, preserving speaker, date, and source identifiers without model inference.
At query time, BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) retrieves candidates, and JEV ( Almeida, 2026 ) scores their contribution to answering the question.
Terms selected deterministically from high-scoring chunks drive one additional BM25 search, followed by JEV rescoring of retained and new candidates in a shared evidence context.
blocks.zh:
在SAG2(Wu, 2026年)的基础上,我们提出SAG-Mem(SAG-Mem),它使证据指导的词典检索适应对话记忆.
它在每场会话中以非重叠的块填充信息,保留扬声器、日期和源标识符,而无需模型推论。
BM25(Robertson and Zaragoza,2009年)在查询时间检索考生,JEV(Almeida,2026年)对回答问题的贡献进行评分.
从高分块中挑选的术语决定了BM25的搜索,然后是JEV在共同证据背景下重新评分保留的候选人和新候选人。

blocks.en:
SAG-Mem-Lite shares the same chunks and lexical expansion, replacing JEV with query–chunk cosine similarity computed using bge-large-en-v1.5 ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) .
It precomputes one embedding per chunk and supports up to two expansion rounds.
Both configurations return source dialogue with date-based annotations of relative-time expressions.
The Reader is instructed to answer from this evidence and abstain when it is insufficient.

SAG-Mem-Lite 共享相同的块和词典扩展,用使用bge-group-en-v1.5(Xiao等人,2024年)计算的查询-chunk 余弦相似性取代JEV。
它预先计算每个块嵌入一个,并最多支持两个扩展回合.
两个配置都返回源对话框,并带有基于日期的相对时间表达式说明.
读者奉命从这些证据中回答,在证据不足时弃权.

blocks.en: The key contributions of SAG-Mem and SAG-Mem-Lite can be summarized as follows: • We present a dialogue-preserving memory design that avoids LLM-based extraction and persistent semantic relation construction, together with date-based annotations that make supported relative-time expressions explicit while preserving the original text and temporal granularity. • We develop seed-based lexical expansion to discover complementary evidence beyond the initial retrieval pool, using JEV-based evidence evaluation in SAG-Mem and embedding-based candidate scoring in SAG-Mem-Lite. • We evaluate both configurations on LoCoMo and LongMemEval. As shown in SAG-Mem-1.0 Technical Report , SAG-Mem achieves overall scores of 83.08 and 80.20, respectively, the highest among the evaluated methods on both benchmarks, while SAG-Mem-Lite achieves 77.09 and 77.20.

blocks.en: 3 SAG-Mem Framework
blocks.zh: 3 SAG- mem 框架

blocks.en:
Section 1 motivated three design decisions: storing complete dialogue instead of extracted memories, discovering cross-session links at query time, and clarifying relative-time expressions before reading.
All three follow one principle: deferring each act of interpretation until the information it needs becomes available.
At write time the question is unknown, so the dialogue is stored verbatim.
At query time the evidence retrieved so far indicates what to look for next, so links between facts are discovered then.
At read time it is known which messages the Reader will see, so relative times are resolved then, for those messages only.
blocks.zh:
第一节激发了三项设计决定:存储完整的对话框而不是提取记忆,在查询时间发现跨会话链接,在阅读前澄清相对时间表达.
这三项文书都遵循一项原则:推迟每项解释行为,直至获得所需信息。
写时问题未知,所以对话框是逐字存储的.
在查询时,迄今收集到的证据表明下一步要寻找什么,因此发现事实之间的联系。
在阅读时,人们知道读者会看到哪些信息,因此相对时间就解决了,仅因为这些信息。

blocks.en: 3.1 Memory Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 记忆建筑

blocks.en:
Memory construction implements Build \operatorname{Build} .
Extraction-based memories decide at write time which details to retain ( Zhong et al., 2024 ; Chhikara et al., 2025 ) .
Because the system cannot know then what a later question will need, SAG-Mem makes no such judgment and stores the dialogue as it was said.
blocks.zh:
内存构建工具 构建\ operatorname{ Build} 。
基于采掘的记忆在书面时间决定保留哪些细节(Zhong等人,2024年;Chhikara等人,2025年)。
因为系统无法知道以后的问题需要什么,所以SAG-Mem没有作出这样的判断,而是按上面所说的存储对话.

blocks.en:
Complete-Message Chunks. We process ℋ \mathcal{H} in source order and group consecutive messages into chunks, each lying within a single session and disjoint from the others.
Packing follows a soft budget of 512 tokens: if appending the next complete message would exceed the budget, the current chunk is closed first.
Token counts use the bge-large-en-v1.5 tokenizer ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) and include rendered headers and special tokens.
The tokenizer serves only as a length measure for packing and takes no part in indexing or scoring.

blocks.en:
Construction produces only verbatim chunks and a lexical index over them, so connecting facts is the job of Retrieve \operatorname{Retrieve} .
Retrieval follows SAG2 ( Wu, 2026 ) , an embedding-free multi-hop retriever over a lexical index.
We adopt its BM25 candidate pool, its evidence scoring with JEV, its selection of the highest-scoring chunks as seeds, its weighting of expansion terms, its per-term retrieval with interleaving, and its protection of the first five BM25 matches.
We change the retrieval unit to complete-message chunks and the budgets to B = 50 B{=}50 and H = 1 H{=}1 , and we define the pool of every round, including the last, as the set U t U_{t} of Section 3.3 , without SAG2’s refilling of the final pool with earlier candidates.
Retrieval proceeds in two steps.
This section finds chunks that overlap the question lexically and selects seeds among them, and Section 3.3 then starts from the seeds to reach bridging chunks that the question alone cannot reach ( Xiong et al., 2019 ) .

blocks.en:
The initial stage yields the seeds, which are chunks that overlap the question and received the highest evidence scores.
What is still missing are facts that share terms with a seed but few with the question itself.

blocks.en:
From the Question to the Evidence. Consider the question “Where does Maya’s mentor live?”.
Session S 1 S_{1} contains Maya’s line “My mentor is Leo.”, which overlaps the question and can become a seed.
Session S 7 S_{7} contains Leo’s line “I live in Kyoto.”, which shares only the verb “live” with the question and mentions neither Maya nor a mentor, so a search issued with q q has little to match it on.
The seed, however, contains the term “Leo”, and so does the rendered text of S 7 S_{7} because the speaker name is part of the chunk.
Searching again with terms from the seed reaches the bridging fact.
A graph-based system would store this edge at write time ( Rasmussen et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026b ) , and iterative retrievers reach it by generating intermediate reasoning or reformulated queries ( Trivedi et al., 2023 ) .
Here it is recovered directly from the text when needed, which is what allows construction to stay lightweight.

blocks.en:
Expansion Terms. Expansion terms are taken directly from the text of the seed chunks, so the step is deterministic and purely lexical.
Unlike generative query expansion ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , it needs no generative model.
It resembles pseudo-relevance feedback ( Rocchio, 1971 ) , except that terms come only from the seeds, which are selected by the scoring function rather than by BM25 rank.
The weight of a term combines four signals, as defined in SAG2: its term frequency, its document frequency in the corpus, the overlap between its sentence and the question, and the score of its seed.
At most 20 terms are kept, and any term composed entirely of question words is dropped because the first search already used it.

blocks.en:
Answer generation implements the rendering g g and the Reader of Eq. ( 2 ).
The retrieved chunks arrive in their original wording, and one act of interpretation remains before the Reader sees them: turning relative-time expressions into calendar dates.

blocks.en:
Time Clarification after Retrieval. The selected chunks ℰ q \mathcal{E}_{q} are rendered in retrieval order with their complete messages, speakers, source dates, and session and message identifiers.
A deterministic renderer inserts a parenthetical date after each supported relative-time expression and keeps the original wording.
For a message dated 2025/05/12, “yesterday” becomes “yesterday (2025/05/11)”.
The renderer consists of pattern matching and calendar arithmetic, following rule-based temporal taggers such as SUTime ( Chang and Manning, 2012 ) and HeidelTime ( Strötgen and Gertz, 2010 ) .
Month-level and year-level expressions keep their granularity, and unsupported expressions are left unchanged.

blocks.en:
We apply this step after retrieval for two reasons.
First, the annotation is needed only for the messages the Reader will see, and each of them carries the date on which it was said, so a rule can take over a computation on which language models remain error-prone ( Fatemi et al., 2024 ) .
Second, the annotation exists only in the Reader’s context: the index, chunk identifiers, and retrieval scores remain unchanged, and the original wording stays available.

其次,注释只存在于读者的语境中:索引、块标识符和检索分数保持不变,原始措辞保持不变。

blocks.en:
Calendar Rules. The renderer applies the following conventions.
Week-level expressions such as “last week” denote a calendar week that runs from Monday to Sunday.
Counted expressions such as “two weeks ago” are instead offsets in days, here 14 days, and do not denote a calendar-week interval.
Weekday expressions follow a separate rule: an English “last” or “next” weekday refers to the nearest matching day strictly before or strictly after the source date.
Approximate expressions stay approximate, and text inside quotations and code is left unchanged.
Dates are written in the form 2025/05/12 , and an inline annotation takes the form yesterday (2025/05/11) .
The rules cover English and Chinese expressions, although the dialogue in the experiments of this report is English.

blocks.en: 3.5 SAG-Mem-Lite
blocks.zh: 3.5 SAG-Mem-Lite卫星

blocks.en:
In the pipeline above, the only retrieval step that spends model inference at query time is JEV scoring.
SAG-Mem-Lite keeps the store, lexical search, expansion procedure, and time rendering unchanged, replaces JEV with embedding similarity, and uses its own search budgets.
Its only model call during retrieval is a single embedding of the question.
blocks.zh:
在以上管道中,在查询时间花费模型推论的唯一检索步骤是JEV评分.
SAG-Mem-Lite保持存储,词典搜索,扩展程序,以及时间渲染不变,以嵌入相似性取代JEV,并使用自己的搜索预算.
它在检索时唯一的模型调用是单嵌入问题.

blocks.en:
Cosine Scoring. SAG-Mem-Lite encodes the question and the chunks with bge-large-en-v1.5 ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) into L2-normalized vectors.
Chunk vectors are computed once at build time, which is the only model cost that SAG-Mem-Lite adds to construction.
A vector is used only for scoring, and x i x_{i} remains the text that is searched and read.
The question is encoded once at query time.

blocks.en:
Scoring without Evidence. In Algorithm 1 , SAG-Mem-Lite sets Score \mathrm{Score} to d Lite d_{\mathrm{Lite}} .
This score depends only on the fixed question vector and ignores the evidence list, so each chunk is scored once and rescoring reduces to scoring the new candidates.

这个分数只取决于固定的提问向量,而忽略了证据列表,因此每个块都得一次分,再得分减少为新考生的分数.

blocks.en:
A Wider Search. Candidates come from the same two sources as in SAG-Mem, the initial BM25 search and lexical expansion.
Unlike in dense retrieval ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ) , the embeddings here only rank these candidates, and no nearest-neighbor search runs over the full store.
Because cosine scoring is inexpensive, SAG-Mem-Lite spends the saved budget on a wider search: up to B = 100 B{=}100 chunks per lexical search and up to H = 2 H{=}2 expansion rounds, the default budgets of SAG2.
The weighting of expansion terms uses the score of the seed; since a cosine value can be negative, the score is mapped to ( d Lite + 1 ) / 2 (d_{\mathrm{Lite}}+1)/2 to keep it non-negative.
The mapping is monotone, so seeds keep their cosine order, and the mapped score enters the term weights in the same way as a JEV score.
blocks.zh:
一个大搜索。 候选者来自与SAG-Mem相同的两个来源,最初的BM25搜索和词汇扩展.

由于余弦积分价格低廉,SAG-Mem-Lite将节省下来的预算花在了更宽的搜索上:每个词典搜索最多达到B = 100 B{=}100块,最多达到H = 2 H{=}2扩展回合,是SAG2的默认预算.

Pool across Rounds. After the first round, up to s s further seeds are selected by cosine score among the chunks of the current pool that have not served as seeds before.
The pool of round t t is U t = P ∪ Z 0 ∪ ⋯ ∪ Z t − 1 ∪ C t U_{t}=P\cup Z_{0}\cup\cdots\cup Z_{t-1}\cup C_{t} : it retains the first five initial BM25 matches and all earlier seeds alongside the new candidates of the round.
The pool is thus rebuilt in every round, and a candidate of an earlier round that is neither in P P nor chosen as a seed leaves it, as the members of C 0 C_{0} outside P ∪ Z 0 P\cup Z_{0} leave after the first round.
Its size in round t t is therefore at most 5 + t ​ s + B 5+ts+B , so the pool grows only by the s s seeds of each round rather than by all earlier candidates.
When the second expansion finds new candidates, a first-round candidate reaches the final list only by being selected as a seed, whereas every candidate of the second round competes for it directly; when it finds none, retrieval stops and U 1 U_{1} is kept.

Cost of the Substitution. The cost of this substitution is that the scores of SAG-Mem-Lite no longer depend on the evidence gathered: a bridging chunk that looks useful only next to a seed is ranked by its similarity to the question alone.
The two variants can therefore rank the same candidates differently and, as a result, select different seeds.
With seeds chosen by question similarity alone, the expansion of SAG-Mem-Lite is closer to pseudo-relevance feedback over a reranked list.
blocks.zh:
替代费用。 这种替换的成本是,SAG-Mem-Lite的分数不再依赖于收集到的证据:一个只看似在种子旁边的桥块,根据它与问题本身的相似性排名.
两种变种因此可以对相同的候选种进行不同的排序,从而选择不同的种子.
由于种子仅通过问题相似性选择,SAG-Mem-Lite的扩展比重新排位榜更接近伪相关反馈.

blocks.en:
In summary, the two variants share the store, the lexical search, the expansion procedure, and the time rendering, and differ in how candidates are scored and in the budgets B B and H H .
A comparison between them is therefore a comparison of two configurations rather than of the scoring functions alone.
Section 4 gives their configurations and evaluates both in terms of accuracy and cost.
blocks.zh:
简言之,两个变体共享商店,词典搜索,扩展程序,以及时间渲染,在考生的得分方式和预算B和H上存在差异.
因此,两者之间的比较是对两个配置的比较,而不仅仅是对评分函数的比较。
第4节从准确性和成本两方面给出了它们的配置和评价.

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Dataset and Models. We evaluate on the text-only setting of LoCoMo ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) (excluding image captions) and the LongMemEval-S benchmark ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , which contain 1,986 and 500 questions, respectively. For both answer generation (Reader) and LLM-as-a-Judge (Judge) ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) , we use two configurations: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 ( Xu et al., 2026a ) .
Both configurations disable thinking mode and provider fallback, using temperature 0.
blocks.zh:
数据集与模型. 我们评价LoCoMo(Maharana等人,2024年)(不包括图像标题)和LongMemEval-S基准(Wu等人,2025年)的文本设置,其中分别包含1 986和500个问题。 对于回答生成(Reader)和LLM-as-a-Judge(Judge)(郑等人,2023年),我们使用两种配置:Qune3.6-35B-A3B-FP8(Quen Team,2026年)和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017(徐等人,2026年a).
两种配置都使用温度来禁用思维模式和提供者倒置 零点

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare SAG-Mem and SAG-Mem-Lite against three groups of baselines: (1) Full Context , which passes the complete conversation history directly to the Reader; (2) Memory-Based Systems , including Zep ( Rasmussen et al., 2025 ) , Mem0 ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) , TencentDB-Agent-Memory (TDAM) ( Tencent Cloud, 2026 ) , and MemOS ( Li et al., 2025 ) ; and (3) Standard RAG Baselines operating over raw conversation history, specifically BM25-only and Dense RAG . All baselines are reproduced under the same Reader and Judge configuration. Table 2 summarizes all software versions and model identifiers.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较了SAG-Mem和SAG-Mem-Lite与三组基线:(1) 完整背景,将完整的对话历史直接传给读者;(2) 基于记忆的系统,包括Zep(Rasmussen等人,2025年),Mem0(Chhikara等人,2025年),Tencent DB-Agent-Memory(TDAM)(Tencent Cloud,2026年),和MemOS(Li等人,2025年);和(3)在原始对话史上运行的标准RAG基线,具体来说是BM25-只和Dense RAG. 所有基线都按照同样的读者和法官配置复制。 表2汇总了所有软件版本和模型标识符.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate performance along three dimensions: • Accuracy: Binary answer correctness judged by LLM-as-a-Judge using dataset-specific semantic matching and abstention prompts, with rare API failures excluded from the denominator. • Retrieval Recall: Session-level and turn-level Recall@ K K for K ∈ { 5 , 10 , 20 } K\in\{5,10,20\} , evaluated against ground-truth evidence annotations over 1,973 annotated LoCoMo questions and all 500 LongMemEval questions. • Efficiency: Monetary cost and end-to-end query latency, measuring query-time retrieval and Reader generation over prebuilt indexes while excluding offline indexing and judging.

blocks.en: Default Configuration. Memory construction and chunking follow the specification in Section 3 . Across both benchmarks, SAG-Mem retrieves up to B = 50 B=50 candidates per round with at most H = 1 H=1 lexical expansion round, whereas SAG-Mem-Lite retains the default SAG2 budgets of B = 100 B=100 and up to H = 2 H=2 rounds. Both variants select s = 10 s=10 expansion seeds, retain up to 20 expansion terms, and pass the top K = 20 K=20 chunks to the Reader. These default settings are held fixed across all main evaluations without per-dataset tuning; we evaluate retrieval parameter sensitivity around this default configuration in Section 4.6 .
blocks.zh: 默认配置 。 内存构造和块化遵循第3节的规格。 在这两个基准中,SAG-Mem每轮检索最多为B=50B=50名候选人,最多为H=1H=1个词汇扩展回合,而SAG-Mem-Lite保留默认的SAG2预算为B=100B=100,最高为H=2H=2轮。 两个变种都选择s = 10 s = 10 膨胀种子,保留最多20个膨胀期,并将顶部的K = 20 K = 20块通过给读者. 这些默认设置被固定在所有主要评价中,而不按数据集进行调试;我们评价第4.6节中围绕这一默认配置的检索参数敏感性。

blocks.en: Unified Cost Accounting. Operational cost covers memory construction, query-time retrieval, and Reader answer generation, excluding offline LLM judging; construction is counted once per distinct conversation history. All systems are priced from logged token counts using official API pricing, accounting for prompt-cache hit discounts across extraction LLMs, search/Reader LLMs, evidence evaluators, and both construction-time and query-time embeddings. Reused retrieval logs contribute their full logical cost to each independent evaluation configuration.
blocks.zh: 统一成本核算。 运营成本包括内存构造,查询时间检索,以及读者答录生成,但不包括离线LLM判断;构造按不同的对话历史计算一次. 所有系统都使用正式的API定价,从登录的令牌计数中计价,计算提取LLMs、搜索/阅读LLMs、证据评估员以及施工时间和查询时间嵌入的快速卡切打折扣。 重新使用的检索日志为每个独立评价配置贡献全部逻辑成本。

blocks.en: 4.2 Overall Effectiveness
blocks.zh: 4.2 总体成效

blocks.en: Overall Comparison under Qwen. Table 3 reports the end-to-end answer accuracy of all evaluated systems under the Qwen configuration. Overall, both SAG-Mem and SAG-Mem-Lite achieve strong performance without relying on LLM-based memory extraction or explicit graph construction, from which we draw three key conclusions: (1) SAG-Mem achieves the highest overall accuracy across both benchmarks, while SAG-Mem-Lite consistently ranks among the top-performing methods. Both variants substantially outperform all memory-based baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of preserving complete source messages and discovering connections at retrieval time. (2) Compared with standard RAG baselines operating over raw conversation history, both SAG-Mem and SAG-Mem-Lite consistently outperform BM25-only and Dense RAG, confirming that evidence-guided lexical expansion and candidate scoring provide gains beyond single-pass retrieval. (3) Relative to Full Context, SAG-Mem maintains an advantage on LoCoMo and delivers a substantial improvement on LongMemEval, where lengthy multi-session histories degrade full-context reading. Although SAG-Mem-Lite trails Full Context on LoCoMo, it outperforms all other memory-based and RAG baselines there and surpasses Full Context on LongMemEval by a wide margin.
blocks.zh: Quen下的总体比较。 表3报告在Quen配置下所有评价系统的端到端答案准确性. 总体而言,SAG-Mem和SAG-Mem-Lite在不依赖基于LLM的内存提取或清晰的图表构造的情况下都取得了强效,我们从中得出了三个关键结论:(1)SAG-Mem在两个基准中都实现了最高的整体准确性,而SAG-Mem-Lite则始终在最高性能方法中排名. 这两个变体都大大超过了所有基于内存的基线,证明了保存完整的源消息和在检索时发现连接的有效性. (2) 与在原始对话历史中运行的标准RAG基线相比,SAG-Mem和SAG-Mem-Lite都一贯优于BM25-Only和Dense RAG,确认由证据指导的词汇扩展和候选人评分提供收益,超出了单程检索。 (3)相对于全景,SAG-Mem在LoCoMo上保持优势,并在LongMemEval上带来实质性的改善,在LongMemEval中,漫长的多会历史降解了全景读物. 虽然SAG-Mem-Lite在LoCoMo上追踪了Full Content,但它的性能超过了那里所有其他基于内存和RAG的基线,在LongMemEval上比Full Content要大得多.

Both variants substantially outperform all memory-based baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of preserving complete source messages and discovering connections at retrieval time.

blocks.en: Category-Level Performance. To examine how different retrieval and rendering components contribute across task types, we further analyze the category-level breakdown in Table 3 under the Qwen configuration. Overall, the advantages of SAG-Mem and SAG-Mem-Lite are most pronounced on categories requiring cross-session evidence connection and temporal grounding: (1) On LoCoMo, SAG-Mem establishes a clear lead on temporal reasoning over all baselines, reflecting the benefit of post-retrieval time clarification. On multi-hop questions, SAG-Mem significantly outperforms all memory-based and standard RAG baselines and closely approaches Full Context; we diagnose this remaining multi-hop gap in Section 4.5 . On adversarial questions, retrieval-based systems, including both SAG-Mem and SAG-Mem-Lite, consistently outperform Full Context in abstention. (2) On LongMemEval, SAG-Mem demonstrates superior performance on multi-session, temporal, and single-session user questions, while both variants achieve perfect accuracy on single-session assistant queries. Meanwhile, SAG-Mem-Lite attains the strongest performance on knowledge updates, surpassing both memory-based baselines and SAG-Mem, indicating that fixed-query embedding scoring over lexically expanded candidate pools is particularly effective for locating updated factual statements.
blocks.zh: 类别级业绩。 为了审查不同检索和渲染组件如何在任务类型之间作出贡献,我们在Quen配置下进一步分析表3中的类别级别细分. 总的来说,SAG-Mem和SAG-Mem-Lite在需要跨会证连接和时间依据的类别方面最突出的优点是: (1) 关于LoCoMo, SAG-Mem就所有基线的时间推理确定了明确的线索,反映了事后时间澄清的好处。 在多跳题上,SAG-Mem显著超越了所有基于内存的标准RAG基线,并紧密接近全上下文;我们在4.5节中诊断了这个剩余的多跳缺口. 关于对抗性问题,基于检索的系统,包括SAG-Mem和SAG-Mem-Lite,以弃权方式一贯超过全面情况。 (2)在LongMemEval上,SAG-Mem在多会、时间和单会次用户问题上表现优异,而两个变体在单会次助理查询上都取得了完美的准确性。 同时,SAG-Mem-Lite在知识更新方面表现得最强,超过了基于内存的基线和SAG-Mem,这表明固定的嵌入积分高于逻辑上扩大的候选人集合对于找到最新的事实陈述特别有效。

blocks.en: Cross-Model Consistency under DeepSeek. To examine whether selective retrieval remains beneficial under a stronger LLM configuration, we conduct a focused cross-model comparison of SAG-Mem and SAG-Mem-Lite against the Full Context reference under DeepSeek, instead of re-evaluating the full baseline suite (whose cost is dominated by write-time memory extraction). Detailed and cross-model results are reported in Table 3 and Table 4 , where both the Reader and Judge switch to the indicated LLM configuration: (1) SAG-Mem again attains the highest overall score on both benchmarks, edging out Full Context by a narrow margin on LoCoMo while maintaining a wide lead on LongMemEval. On LongMemEval, both SAG-Mem and SAG-Mem-Lite continue to outperform Full Context by a wide margin across most categories. (2) Moving from the Qwen configuration to DeepSeek yields higher overall scores for all three evaluated methods, reflecting the joint change in both the Reader and Judge models. Consequently, the relative lead of SAG-Mem over Full Context narrows under DeepSeek, becoming a small edge on LoCoMo. blocks.en: 4.3 System Efficiency: Cost and Latency

blocks.en: Monetary Cost and Token Breakdown. SAG-Mem-1.0 Technical Report summarizes the accuracy–cost trade-off, and Table 5 reports the total monetary cost and stage-level token breakdown of all evaluated systems under the Qwen configuration, separating write-time extraction and embedding from query-time retrieval and Reader generation. Overall, eliminating write-time LLM extraction yields decisive cost advantages as conversation histories scale, from which we draw three key observations: (1) Memory-based baselines incur substantial write-time LLM extraction costs, which dominate their total expenditure on LongMemEval where hundreds of independent histories must be indexed. In contrast, both SAG-Mem and SAG-Mem-Lite require zero extraction LLM tokens, keeping their total cost one to two orders of magnitude lower than memory-based systems on LongMemEval. On LoCoMo, where many queries share a small set of histories, write-time extraction amortizes more easily; SAG-Mem-Lite remains cheaper than all memory-based baselines, whereas SAG-Mem allocates its budget to query-time JEV scoring and falls between the lighter memory baselines (Mem0 and MemOS) and the heavier ones (TDAM and Zep). (2) SAG-Mem-Lite achieves the lowest total cost among Full Context and all memory-based baselines across both benchmarks, remaining comparable in cost to standard RAG baselines while delivering higher accuracy. Because it relies on lightweight lexical expansion and precomputed chunk embeddings, its primary overhead on LongMemEval lies in one-time embedding construction, which amortizes cleanly over subsequent queries. By comparison, SAG-Mem eliminates embedding costs entirely and allocates most of its budget to query-time JEV evidence scoring, resulting in higher cost than SAG-Mem-Lite on LoCoMo yet still substantially undercutting Full Context and all memory-based baselines on LongMemEval. (3) Selective retrieval reduces Reader token usage relative to Full Context on both benchmarks. On LongMemEval, this reduction yields substantial total cost savings for both variants. On LoCoMo, the estimated total cost of SAG-Mem is 54% lower than Full Context under the same uncached Reader rates, including query-time JEV scoring.

blocks.en:
Evidence-Guided Lexical Expansion. Table 7 compares the full SAG-Mem retrieval pipeline ( H = 1 H=1 ) against a no-expansion control ( H = 0 H=0 ) under the Qwen configuration, which retains initial BM25 candidates, initial JEV scoring, and post-retrieval time clarification while removing the lexical expansion round and rescoring with evidence.
Removing the expansion round leads to a pronounced accuracy drop on both LoCoMo and LongMemEval, confirming that initial-query matching alone misses complementary facts needed for cross-session questions.
This consistent gain across both benchmarks validates that using selected source chunks to guide a lexical expansion round and rescoring with evidence is a primary contributor to the effectiveness of SAG-Mem.

We compare three rendering settings: Main combines normalized date headers with inline date annotations for supported relative-time expressions, Raw dates keeps the original message headers without inline annotations, and Date only normalizes the headers while omitting inline annotations. (1) On LoCoMo, Main delivers substantial accuracy gains over both Raw dates and Date only for SAG-Mem and SAG-Mem-Lite. In contrast, Date only offers no advantage over Raw dates , indicating that explicit inline date annotations for relative-time expressions are essential for the Qwen Reader. (2) On LongMemEval, the effect is smaller: Main improves over both controls for SAG-Mem-Lite, whereas for SAG-Mem it matches Raw dates and edges out Date only . Across both benchmarks, deterministic post-retrieval time clarification provides consistent or positive gains without modifying stored indexes or incurring additional LLM calls.

blocks.en:
Retrieval-Layer Recall. Table 10 reports session-level and turn-level Recall@5/10/20 for SAG-Mem and SAG-Mem-Lite across both benchmarks, decoupling retrieval coverage from downstream Reader generation.
SAG-Mem consistently achieves high session-level and turn-level recall on both LoCoMo and LongMemEval, capturing the vast majority of supporting evidence within the top-5 chunks and approaching saturation by K = 20 K=20 .
By comparison, SAG-Mem-Lite trails SAG-Mem at tighter cutoffs, especially on turn-level recall, yet substantially narrows the gap at K = 20 K=20 .
This divergence reflects the benefit of JEV evidence scoring in concentrating gold evidence into top ranks, while explaining why SAG-Mem-Lite remains competitive in end-to-end accuracy once twenty chunks are supplied to the Reader.

Multi-Hop Bottleneck Analysis. To diagnose the remaining multi-hop gap relative to Full Context under Qwen in Section 4.2 , we perform a targeted retrieval-budget sweep and error attribution on the LoCoMo multi-hop subset using SAG-Mem ( Table 11 and Table 12 ).
The diagnostic results show that this gap does not stem from a failure to locate gold evidence, but instead reflects an interaction between the returned chunk budget K K and Reader-side multi-hop reasoning.
At the default setting ( K = 20 , H = 1 K=20,H=1 ), message and session coverage are already high, and expanding K K or adding a second lexical expansion round ( H = 2 H=2 ) produces negligible changes in aggregate coverage.
Nevertheless, enlarging K K from 20 to 40 yields a clear accuracy gain that closes and reverses the gap to Full Context, after which accuracy saturates at K = 60 K=60 .
This pattern aligns with the sensitivity to K K observed on LongMemEval in Section 4.6 : even when most annotated gold turns are already retrieved, additional chunks supply surrounding conversational context and remaining partial hops that help the Qwen Reader link scattered facts, at the cost of a larger Reader context.
Adding a second expansion round ( H = 2 H=2 ) also improves accuracy modestly while increasing query-time JEV scoring overhead.
As detailed in Table 12 , complete retrieval misses account for only a small fraction of failures under both H = 1 H=1 and H = 2 H=2 , while the vast majority of errors still occur on questions with gold evidence already present in the Reader context.
Combined with the DeepSeek results in Section 4.2 , where SAG-Mem surpasses Full Context even at K = 20 K=20 , these diagnostics indicate that default multi-hop accuracy is jointly bounded by the K = 20 K=20 context trade-off and Reader reasoning capacity.

blocks.en: 4.6 Hyperparameter Sensitivity Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.6 超参数灵敏度分析

blocks.en: To examine how retrieval budgets affect performance without incurring full-benchmark JEV evaluation costs across all parameter combinations, we conduct a sensitivity sweep for SAG-Mem under the Qwen configuration on a category-stratified 125-question subset of LongMemEval, complementing the LoCoMo multi-hop budget sweep in Section 4.5 . We vary three core retrieval hyperparameters around the fixed default configuration ( default : B = 50 , H = 1 , K = 20 B=50,H=1,K=20 ): the per-round candidate pool size B B , the maximum number of lexical expansion rounds H H , and the number of chunks passed to the Reader K K ( Table 13 ). Overall, subset accuracy responds noticeably to retrieval budget adjustments across all three dimensions, while the fixed default setting provides a balanced trade-off between accuracy and query-time overhead: (1) Among the three parameters, accuracy is most sensitive to the returned chunk budget K K . Reducing K K below the default lowers accuracy, whereas doubling K K yields the largest single-parameter gain on the subset at the cost of doubling the Reader input context. (2) Adjusting the candidate pool size B B and expansion depth H H produces asymmetric effects. Shrinking B B leaves subset accuracy unchanged, whereas disabling lexical expansion ( H = 0 H=0 ) degrades accuracy, consistent with the full-benchmark ablation in Section 4.4 . Doubling either B B or H H yields identical moderate gains on the subset, though both increase query-time JEV scoring overhead.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
Memory Representation and Organization. External conversational memories differ in the granularity of stored content and the structures used to organize it ( Hu et al., 2025 ) .
Summarization and reflection produce compact descriptions of past interactions or experiences, including event summaries, user profiles, and higher-level insights ( Zhong et al., 2024 ; Park et al., 2023 ; Tan et al., 2025 ) .
Other approaches represent salient information as persistent facts or self-contained discourse units, preserving details for fine-grained retrieval ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ; Zhou and Han, 2025 ) .
Hierarchical designs organize memory into tiers and manage information transfer or consolidation across them ( Packer et al., 2023 ; Fang et al., 2026 ) .
Temporal knowledge graphs and linked-note structures maintain associations among memories and their context ( Rasmussen et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026b ) .
Our framework preserves complete dialogue messages and their metadata in chunks, avoiding LLM-based memory rewriting and persistent semantic relation construction.
blocks.zh:
记忆代表与组织. 外部对话记忆在存储内容的颗粒性和用于组织的内容的结构上有所不同(Hu等人,2025年).
总结和反思对以往的相互作用或经验作了紧凑的描述,包括事件摘要、用户简介和更高层次的见解(Zhong等人,2024年;Park等人,2023年;Tan等人,2025年)。
其他方法作为持续的事实或自成一体的论述单元,代表着显著信息,为精细检索保留细节(Chhikara等人,2025年;周和汉,2025年)。
分级设计将内存组织成分级,并管理跨级信息传输或整合(Packer等人,2023年;Fang等人,2026年).
时间知识图和链接注释结构维持记忆及其背景之间的关联(Rasmussen等人,2025年;徐等人,2026年b ).
我们的框架以块形式保存完整的对话信息及其元数据,避免基于LLM的内存重写和持续的语义关系构建.

blocks.en:
Memory Retrieval Strategy. Retrieval strategies seek supporting evidence beyond the matches returned for the original question.
Relevance feedback and adaptive re-ranking use initial results or highly scored documents to guide subsequent search ( Lavrenko and Croft, 2017 ; MacAvaney et al., 2022 ) .
Generated reasoning steps, draft answers, and predicted continuations provide additional retrieval cues ( Trivedi et al., 2023 ; Qian et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ) .
Graph-based retrieval exploits entity and passage connectivity to recover evidence distributed across documents ( Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ; Gutiérrez et al., 2025 ) .
SAG ( Wu et al., 2026 ) connects source passages at query time through shared entities in an event–entity index.
SAG2 ( Wu, 2026 ) combines BM25 retrieval with decision-model evidence scoring and lexical expansion from selected passages, without offline embedding computation or LLM-based relation extraction.
Our work adapts SAG2’s evidence-guided lexical expansion to conversational memory and evaluates JEV-based and embedding-based scoring configurations.
blocks.zh:
内存检索策略. 检索策略在为原始问题返回的匹配值之外寻求支持证据。
相关性反馈和适应性的重新排序使用初始结果或高分文档来指导后续搜索(Lavrenko and Croft, 2017; MacAvaney et al., 2022).
生成推理步骤、起草答案和预测续作提供了额外的检索提示(Trivedi等人,2023年;Qian等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2023年)。
基于图表的检索利用实体和通道的连通性,以收回通过文件分发的证据(Gutiérrez等人,2024年;Gutiérrez等人,2025年)。
SAG(Wu et al., 2026)在查询时间通过事件-实体索引中的共享实体连接源段落.
SAG2(Wu, 2026)将BM25检索与决策模型证据评分和词汇扩展从选定的段落合并,没有离线嵌入计算或基于LLM的关系提取.
我们的工作将SAG2的实证指导词典扩展适应对话记忆,并评价基于JEV和嵌入式的评分配置.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented SAG-Mem and SAG-Mem-Lite, two configurations of a conversational memory framework that preserves complete dialogue messages and discovers complementary evidence through seed-based lexical expansion.
SAG-Mem combines model-free memory construction with JEV-based evidence evaluation, while SAG-Mem-Lite uses precomputed chunk embeddings for candidate scoring.
Both configurations append date-based interpretations of supported relative-time expressions while preserving the original text and temporal granularity.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了SAG-Mem和SAG-Mem-Lite,这是对话记忆框架的两个配置,通过种子词典扩展来保存完整的对话信息并发现补充证据.
SAG-Mem将无模型内存构建与基于JEV的证据评价相结合,而SAG-Mem-Lite则使用预计算块嵌入来进行候选评分.
两种配置都附加了对支持的相对时表达式基于日期的解释,同时保留了原始文本和时间颗粒性.

blocks.en:
On LoCoMo and LongMemEval, SAG-Mem achieves overall scores of 83.08 and 80.20 with Qwen3.6-35B, and 83.99 and 82.60 with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, respectively, outperforming the Full Context baseline in all four settings.
SAG-Mem-Lite achieves corresponding scores of 77.09 and 77.20 with Qwen, and 81.22 and 81.60 with DeepSeek, while maintaining low query latency and lower operational cost than Full Context and all memory-based baselines.
These results support dialogue preservation and evidence-guided retrieval expansion as an effective design for long-term conversational memory across both evaluated LLM configurations.
blocks.zh:
在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上,SAG-Mem分别以Qwen3.6-35B和Depseek-V4.1-Flash分别取得了83.08和80.20的总分,在所有四个设置中都超过了全景基线.
SAG-Mem-Lite在与Quen同时实现77.09分和77.20分,与DeepSeek同时实现81.22分和81.60分,同时保持低查询空闲,运营成本低于Full Content和所有基于内存的基线.
这些成果支持对话保存和以证据指导的检索扩展,作为长期对话记忆的有效设计,涵盖两个经评价的LLM配置。

Shared State. The candidates of a request share one state, which holds the question and the explicit evidence list and, in stateful mode, also the passages of all candidates in the request and the common scoring instruction.

blocks.en:
Packing Determinism.. Requests are sent concurrently and scores are written back by candidate identifier.
The client-side packing, and with it V t ​ ( i ) V_{t}(i) , is therefore fixed by the pool and its order and does not depend on the returned scores.
When a candidate or the evidence itself has to be divided, the candidate keeps the maximum of its partial scores, while the stored chunk stays whole.
This guarantees deterministic request construction on the client side; separate end-to-end runs calling the remote JEV API can still exhibit minor floating-point score fluctuations near seed-selection boundaries, accounting for small coverage variations across independent runs ( Table 11 ).
